rules: Run registered CLI Discovery and use its declared safe help invocation before invoking a retained Bemoat command.
CLI help is read-only and changes no GitHub, branch, or local workflow state.
Context is read-only; Handoff records evidence but does not authorize a new objective or grant approval.
Only one bounded objective may execute at a time; durable result and Handoff precede fresh Context and authorization for the next objective.
STOP and FOUNDER_GATE are human-owned boundaries; no autonomous merge, approval, or invented authority.
Assert a specific route only when canonical authority uniquely determines it.
Where authority only forbids an outcome, assert the exclusion without inventing a fallback.
Where multiple outcomes remain plausible, classify SPEC_GAP and stop before encoding a route.

treat HANDOFF as permission or approval
